criteria_results.text: The web prototype presents the Rhythm application shell and a usable Agents session workspace.
criteria_results.notes: The live browser showed the full product navigation, Agents rail, active transcript, composer, inspector, and deterministic session state.

criteria_results.text: Nested child and grandchild sessions are reachable through the transcript and return through one-hop parent breadcrumbs.
criteria_results.notes: The smoke opened Volunteer coverage audit, then Livestream reply verification, and returned to the root session through the two one-hop parent controls.

criteria_results.text: Child-agent transcripts and their composer controls remain read only.
criteria_results.notes: Both nested transcript fixtures displayed Read only; the textbox, send/cancel action, agent, model, permission, reasoning, Fast, and attachment controls were disabled.

criteria_results.text: Agent Memory exposes an endpoint-traceable retryable error and recovers deterministically.
criteria_results.notes: Selecting Server error rendered a 503 state for GET /agent-memory; Try again restored the two seeded memories and a recovery receipt.

criteria_results.text: The composer safely handles an oversized deterministic fixture and allows the user to remove it.
criteria_results.notes: The live picker attached full-transcript.json as first 100 KB / truncated, announced the truncation, and removed the pending attachment through its named control.

suggested_follow_up: Keep Electron packaging deferred until the user accepts this verified web-only prototype, then add a separately signed and notarized packaging track.
